tigrinya: ነበረያ ነበረ! ኣብ ጫካ እንስሳታት ብሰላም ይነብሩ።
english: Long ago, animals lived peacefully in a forest.
Their leader and king was Aya Anbesa.

tigrinya: ሓደ መዓልቲ፣ ኣድጊን ነብርን ከዕልሉ ጀመሩ።
english: One day, the donkey and the leopard began chatting.

tigrinya: ኣድጊ ነቲ ሳዕሪ እናረኣየ፣ «እዚ ሳዕሪ ሰማያዊ እዩ» በለ።
english: Looking at the grass, the donkey said, 'This grass is blue.'

tigrinya: ነብሪ «ኣይፋልካን፣ ቀጠልያ እዩ፣ ዓይንኻ ድዩ ተበላሽዩ?» ኢሉ መለሰ።
english: The leopard replied, 'No, it is green! Are your eyes broken?'

tigrinya: «ንዑ ናብ ንጉስና ኣያ ኣንበሳ ንኺድ» ተባሃሃሉ።
english: 'Let us go to King Aya Anbesa,' they said.

tigrinya: ኣድጊ «ኦ ንጉስ፣ እዚ ሳዕሪ ሰማያዊ ምዃኑ ይካትዓኒ ኣሎ» በሎ።
english: Donkey said, 'O King, he disputes that this grass is blue.'

tigrinya: ኣያ ኣንበሳ «እወ፣ እቲ ሳዕሪ ሰማያዊ እዩ» ኢሉ ፈረደ።
english: Aya Anbesa calmly ruled, 'Yes, the grass is blue.'

tigrinya: ነብሪ ሓዚኑ «ኦ ንጉስ፣ ስለምንታይ ሰማያዊ እዩ ኢልካ ፈሪድካ?» ሓተቶ።
english: Saddened, the leopard asked, 'O King, why did you rule it is blue?'

tigrinya: ንጉስ ኣያ ኣንበሳ፦ «እቲ ሳዕሪ ቀጠልያ ምዃኑስ ኣጸቢቐ እፈልጥ እየ።»
english: King Aya Anbesa said: 'I know very well that the grass is green.'

tigrinya: «ምስ ሓደ ዓሻ ኣድጊ ግዜኻ ኣጥፊእካ ክትካታዕ ስለዝወሰንካ እዩ!»
english: 'Because you chose to waste your time arguing with a foolish donkey!'
Understanding his king's wisdom, the leopard went on his way.
